ui_bugs.issue: Wizard Step 2 crashed with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')` inside Picker. Root cause: new.tsx imports options from src/options.ts and references O.PRODUCTION_LEVELS, O.TONES, O.PACINGS but options.ts only exported CREW_SIZES, MOODS (no PACINGS). This blocked the entire New Project → Generate flow. I added temporary aliases in /app/frontend/src/options.ts to unblock E2E testing (PRODUCTION_LEVELS = CREW_SIZES, TONES = MOODS, PACINGS = [Slow, Medium, Fast, Dynamic (varied)]). Main agent should decide the canonical naming (rename in options.ts OR update new.tsx to use CREW_SIZES/MOODS + add a real PACINGS list).

rca_of_issue: Wizard Step 2 crash — RCA: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/new.tsx the Picker's `options` prop was passed `O.PRODUCTION_LEVELS`, `O.TONES`, `O.PACINGS` (lines 95, 105, 106) but src/options.ts only exported CREW_SIZES, MOODS (and no PACINGS at all). At runtime these resolved to `undefined`, so the Picker's `options.map(...)` threw. Reproduction: signup → tap 'Create New Storyboard' → fill Project title → tap Continue → red-screen console error and continue button no longer advances. Mitigation applied: added PRODUCTION_LEVELS = CREW_SIZES, TONES = MOODS, PACINGS = [Slow, Medium, Fast, Dynamic (varied)] aliases at the bottom of src/options.ts. Wizard now completes end-to-end and real AI generation succeeds.
